colour_meaning: Look first: an official warning record, or two signs of risk together.

reasons.title: A bidder has a reported link to an official or investigation
reasons.detail: CENTERWAYS CONSTRUCTION AND DEVELOPMENT INC.: documented link to Francis "Chiz" Escudero (Senator; Senate President 2024-2025): Centerways owner and president Lawrence Lubiano gave PHP 30M to Escudero's 2022 Senate campaign; Escudero admitted receiving it and received a COMELEC show-cause order; Lubiano sai [admitted, 2025-10-08; as reported]
more: CENTERWAYS CONSTRUCTION AND DEVELOPMENT INC.: documented link to Francis "Chiz" Escudero (Senator; Senate President 2024-2025): COMELEC terminated its probe, finding no evidence that Lubiano violated s.95(c) of the Omnibus Election Code; the Supreme Court dismissed a petition for review on 3 Jun 2026 as the [cleared, 2025-11; as reported]
reasons.evidence: From the team's register of company–person links reported in the news or hearings. Reported, not proven.
checks: Read the source article; confirm the link is stated there, not inferred.
Look for an official document (SEC filing, COA report, Ombudsman complaint) that confirms it.

reasons.title: Price per km above 90% of similar works
reasons.detail: Official budget ₱93.8M per km; the 90th percentile of similar works (Preventive maintenance / asphalt, 459 past contracts) is ₱78.6M per km. Length read from the title: 455 m.
reasons.evidence: A weaker version of the price sign.
checks: Check the stated length and the scope, as for the stronger price sign.

reasons.title: A bidder had a contract terminated before
reasons.detail: Ed1son Development & Construction Inc.: 1 of 138 earlier road contracts terminated; Syndtite Construction Corporation: 1 of 214 earlier road contracts terminated; V.R. Patron Builders & Developers Corp. (Previousl: 3 of 192 earlier road contracts terminated
reasons.evidence: In past contracts, a winner with an earlier termination had about 2.1 times the odds of another; this held on 2023–2025 data.
checks: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.
